info.description:
GLIMPSE application API. Authenticated per-user storage and orchestration around the
frozen fs-1.3 forecasting model.

Research prototype. Forecasts, alerts, nutrition estimates and medication content are
informational. They are not a diagnosis and not medication or insulin dosing advice.
Prediction uncertainty is not calibrated.
info.title: GLIMPSE Application API

delete.description:
Irreversible. Removes every row owned by the user and every stored meal photo.

Provider tokens are revoked upstream on a best-effort basis first; a provider that
cannot be reached does not block deletion of our copy.

put.description:
Appends a record; nothing is overwritten, so the history stays auditable.

Withdrawing `necessary_processing` immediately blocks every endpoint that stores or
processes health data. It does not delete what is already stored: deletion is the
separate, explicit `DELETE /account`. Withdrawing `personalization_history` stops
completed meals being used as personal history from the next forecast onward.

get.description:

and what it has made visible so far, plus the glucose source -- which is NOT
simulated: it is a historical research recording being replayed.

post.description:
Marks the profile `demo_simulated` and makes its simulated observations up to
the current replay position visible through `GET /wearables/observations`. Later
ones appear as the replay advances. **Idempotent.**

No provider is contacted, no account is linked and no token is created. Profiles:
`apple_health`, `apple_watch`, `fitbit`, `whoop`.

post.description:
Moves forward only. Each checkpoint first releases the historical readings up
to its instant, then performs its action through the ordinary v2 endpoints:
`meal_forecast` logs the dataset's meal record and requests a forecast;
`outcome_reveal` asks for the outcome once the response window and grace period
have passed. Read the results with the normal endpoints (`/meals`,
`/predictions`, `/meals/{id}/outcome`, `/alerts`, `/cgm/readings`).

post.summary: Advance the replay to the next or a named checkpoint

post.description:
Runs the frozen fs-1.3 model and stores the forecast with the exact inputs used.

Idempotent: one forecast exists per confirmation revision, and a repeat request
returns the stored one with `replayed: true`. `forecast` is exactly the contract
v1.0 `ForecastResponse`.

The upload half of the Apple Health bridge. A browser cannot read HealthKit; a
native iOS client reads the types the user granted and posts them here.
Idempotent on `source_record_id`.

These values are stored and displayed. They are not inputs to the forecast.
